caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden display cabinet with a glass front door and glass side panels, rendered in a red-brown color with gold trim along the edges. The cabinet stands on four equally spaced, turned wooden legs. Behind the glass door, there are two horizontal shelves, and the background of the cabinet's interior displays a painted scene. The scene consists of several figures in ancient-style clothing gathered around a classical stone staircase and architecture, with trees and a greenish-blue landscape visible in the background. The overall composition is centered on a cream-colored background with no additional elements or objects surrounding the cabinet. A small caption, "Ancile Bulane," is printed in fine script below and to the right of the cabinet.
title: Zoar Cupboard
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
